channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 November 2026 Cut-Off)
item.description: The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Programmatic Open Call (public programs)
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 1,000 total per selected program, covering all costs including speaker and performer fees, travel, materials and equipment rental; proposals using external funding or smaller budgets welcome. The Museum sets ticket prices and keeps ticket revenue. No application fee.

item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.description: Lower Manhattan Cultural Council (LMCC) · deadline 12 Nov 2026 · USD 1,000 to 20,000 per grant for public arts events in Manhattan between January and December 2027. No application fee.

item.description: Culture Push · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · USD 2,250 stipend, plus fiscal sponsorship for fundraising, mentorship and strategizing support, per the umbrella Fellowship for Utopian Practice guidelines. No application fee.

item.description: Puffin Foundation Ltd. · deadline 20 Nov 2026 · Maximum grant USD 3,500; typical awards smaller. No application fee.

International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.description: Data Through Design (DxD) · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · USD 900 stipend per selected project, paid half in the weeks leading up to the exhibition and half after. No application fee.

item.title: Script Pipeline: First Look Project 2026 (screenplay and TV pilot contest)
item.description: Script Pipeline · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 15,000 in total prizes across six winners: USD 2,500 to the winner of each of four screenplay genre categories (Action and Sci-Fi, Comedy, Drama, Horror and Thriller) and USD 2,500 to the winner of each of two TV pilot categories (hour and half-hour). All winners also receive long-term circulation to Script Pipeline's industry network of producers, managers, agents and directors, 1-on-1 development assistance from Script Pipeline execs, additional script reviews and consideration of other material, career guidance and mentorship, and invitations to private Symposium events. Entry fee: USD 60 at the regular deadline, rising to USD 65 (late, 15 October) and USD 70 (extended, 30 October).

item.description: Gurl Grant (Kat VanCleave) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 2,500 cash grant toward the production of a narrative short film, awarded twice yearly. No application fee.

item.title: Black Public Media: BPM Open Call 2026 (USD 20,000 for nonfiction features)
item.description: Black Public Media · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · USD 20,000 in production funding for up to five projects, each also invited to pitch at PitchBLACK in June 2027, where one project receives an additional USD 150,000 award. Structured as licensing agreements for public media distribution. Free to apply.

item.title: AAPI Fund: Creative Catalyst Fellowship 2027 (theme Belonging)
item.description: AAPI Civic Engagement Fund · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to eight artists each receive USD 30,000 to produce new work. Also covered: the two-day Fellows retreat (travel and accommodation paid by the AAPI Fund), an accomplished communications consultant, digital advertising, community introductions, exhibition placement support and replica development (posters, books, calendars) promoting the finished work. No application fee.

item.title: A.I.R. Gallery: Fellowship Program 2027-2028 (NYC)
item.description: A.I.R. Gallery · deadline 10 Nov 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend per fellow, plus a solo exhibition at A.I.R. Gallery, 4 to 5 professional development workshops, an assigned artist-mentor, a studio visit with a review panelist and ongoing staff support. Six fellows selected. No application fee stated.

item.description: Humanity AI (coalition of 10 philanthropies) · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · USD 10 million total pool, grants of USD 75,000 to 1,000,000 across three tiers: Tier 1 USD 75,000-150,000; Tier 2 USD 150,000-500,000; Tier 3 USD 500,000-1,000,000. Grants run up to three years. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Digital Content Open Call
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Flat honorarium of USD 2,500 to 5,000 per selected proposal, at the Museum's discretion

Nearly USD 40,000 in total awards, including Oscar-qualifying prizes. Entry fee for the final deadline tier is USD 100 (the earlier USD 65 and USD 80 tiers have passed).

item.title: American-Scandinavian Foundation: Fellowships for Americans in the Nordic Countries 2027-28
item.description: American-Scandinavian Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Long-term fellowships of up to USD 23,000 for 4 to 12 months; short-term grants of up to USD 5,000 for 1 to 3 months. item.title: apexart Open Calls: Curatorial Proposals for NYC and International Exhibitions
item.description: apexart · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 10,000 per selected exhibition: USD 8,000 for expenses (curator travel, artwork shipping, artist and participant honorariums, equipment, installation) plus an honorarium of up to USD 2,000 for the curator/organizer. For exhibitions outside NYC, apexart matches up to USD 1,000 for venue rental if needed. apexart additionally covers insurance, advertising, publicity, brochure design/printing/mailing, the opening reception and (for NYC) documentation, and handles most logistics. No application fee.

item.title: Netflix x NALIP Director Incubator 2026-27 (short film grants)
item.description: NALIP (National Association of Latino Independent Producers) with Netflix · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 45,000 production grant for each of four selected directors to create an original narrative short film, plus individualized guidance, career development opportunities, and an industry showcase. No application fee, but current NALIP membership is required to apply.

item.title: Frameline Completion Fund 2027
item.description: Frameline · deadline 09 Oct 2026 · Grants of up to USD 5,000, with a standard range of USD 1,000 to 5,000; the jury can recommend amounts above or below that range. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BAVC MediaMaker Fellowship 2027
    https://bavc.org/programs/mediamaker/
    BAVC Media (Bay Area Video Coalition) · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 distributed to each Fellow over the course of the fellowship, plus travel per diems. Non-cash support includes flights and accommodation for two San Francisco convenings, festival and conference access with travel covered, professional mentorship and strategy sessions, five hours of one-to-one mentorship through MediaMaker Connect, and ongoing workshops. Bay Area fellows also get access to BAVC's co-working space and facilities. No application fee.
  • Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • LATITUDE Artist in Residence 2027 (Chicago)
    https://www.latitudechicago.org/artist-in-residence
    LATITUDE Chicago · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · One-month production residency for 8-10 artists: a $1,000 printing stipend, unlimited scanning, a personal studio with a calibrated workstation, staff training and guidance on tech, an organised public event, and lifetime free lab access. No housing stipend. Free to apply before 16 August 2026; a $20 donation thereafter.
  • Arts in Community Grants 2027
    https://www.southarts.org/grants-opportunities/arts-community-grants
    South Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to USD 10,000 per project, covering artist fees. A dollar-for-dollar cash match is required, so a USD 10,000 request needs USD 10,000 in matching funds. Minimum artist fee is USD 4,000 and the minimum grant request is USD 2,000. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• CPR Center for Performance Research: Artist-in-Residence Program 2027
    https://www.cprnyc.org/events/opencall-2027airprogram
    CPR - Center for Performance Research · deadline 24 Aug 2026 · $2,000 stipend, 20 free hours of rehearsal space, up to 150 subsidised rehearsal hours across CPR's two studios with priority and advance booking, presentation slots in the OPEN LAB and OPEN AiR programmes, and access to technical equipment and production support. No application fee.
  • Surel's Place: Month-Long Artist Residency (September 2026 deadline)
    https://surelsplace.org/month-long-residencies/
    Surel's Place · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Free rent, utilities and wi-fi, a living stipend of USD 100 per week, a USD 300 travel stipend, use of well-maintained bicycles, free or discounted tickets to art events and movies, marketing through Surel's Place channels, and event hosting including logistics and installation help. Each resident also gets a local host to orient them and host their public events. No application fee. NOTE: Surel's Place takes a commission on sales arising from the residency, 35% of retail price on artwork, 45% on ticketed events that are offsite or need contracted services (calculated after administrative expenses), and 15% on books, CDs or other merchandise tangential to the artist's medium. A surcharge may apply to cover additional utility costs if a partner joins.
  • Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Wave Hill: 2027 Sunroom Project Space (NYC)
    https://wavehill.slideroom.com/#/login/program/89416
    Wave Hill · deadline 09 Aug 2026 · $2,000 honorarium per artist, plus exhibition and professional development support, a co-designed Meet the Artist public program, and a short exhibition essay published in print and online. Four artists selected. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Exhibition Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/exhibition-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000. Direct costs only (artist payments, catalogue and publication, artist-designed public programmes); staff salaries excluded. Request must not exceed 25 percent of total direct project costs, which functions as a de facto 75 percent co-financing requirement. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Multi-year Program Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/multi-year-program-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000 across two years. Request must not exceed 25 percent of the organisation's annual operating budget. No formal match, but the 25 percent cap means the balance must come from elsewhere. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Project Grants for Small-Scale Organizations (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/project-grants-for-small-scale-organizations/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 20,000 to 30,000 toward direct costs such as artist payments and production. No application fee.
  • Pandora Short Film Grant 2026
    https://pandora.org/
    Pandora Short Film Grant · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $12,000 production grant to the winner, plus a Panavision camera package (worth about $15,000), an optional $1,000 Kodak Film Grant toward film stock and lab expenses, mentorship from an award-winning filmmaker, and fiscal sponsorship. Three finalists receive mentorship, fiscal sponsorship, consideration for the Panavision New Filmmaker Program, and $500 off Athos production insurance. ENTRY FEE: tiered, $30 regular ($27 Gold members) and $40 late ($36); Pandora states fee waivers are available on request.

item.description:

    https://www.wassaicproject.org/apply
